title: Input quality and missing measurements
content: Validate the exact ordered numeric predictor schema. Reject unknown columns, infinite values and all-missing snapshots. Apply the frozen development-only missingness limit. A rejected snapshot yields insufficient evidence, not an APS or other-fault score. Preserve the raw import and quarantine reason; never invent or fill measurements outside the trained transformation.
check: Compare the import schema and missingness with the frozen data contract, then inspect the stored quarantine reason.
